announcements.title: Outreach This Saturday
announcements.body: We shall be meeting at the UCU main gate at 8:00 am sharp. Please come with your Bibles and comfortable shoes. Transport will be provided.
announcements.author: Outreach Director

announcements.title: Mid-Semester Praise Night
announcements.body: Join us for a powerful night of worship this Friday at 6:00 pm in the Main Hall. Theme: 'The Manifest Presence'.
announcements.author: Worship Lead

announcements.title: Follow-up Training
announcements.body: All ministers are required to attend the follow-up training session on Monday at 4:00 pm in Room B101.
announcements.author: Follow-up Lead
